Subject: Post-call: Procurement & commercial path (PO vs Card / Marketplace) + MAP

Thanks again for taking the time today, Jordan — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared record.

Call recap:
- Use case: multi-tenant embeddings + chat for support search (pilot ~5M tokens/month).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 and < $0.002/1k tokens unit economics for inference.
- Risk areas: security questionnaire (SSP/SOC2 evidence), procurement cadence, and final contract path (PO vs card).

Commercial / procurement questions we flagged on the call (please confirm):
1) Preferred payment path: PO via Finance (typical for deals > $100k/year) OR corporate card for small pilots (<= $10k).
2) Marketplace interest: Is AcmeCloud open to purchasing via AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace if that speeds procurement?
3) Contract: Will AcmeCloud sign Redwood's MSA, or do you need us to review/sign your MSA?

Proposed procurement milestones (draft MAP):
- Legal review (MSA) -> Security/infosec review (SSP/SOC2 + evidence) -> Finance/Procurement signoff -> PO issuance / Marketplace order -> Kickoff.
- Suggested timing: legal 1-2 weeks, security 1-2 weeks after initial docs, finance/PO 1 week after legal + security (dependent on internal SLAs).

Attachments:
- 20260307-MAP-AcmeCloud.xlsx (draft mutual action plan / timeline)
- SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (list of common evidence items to speed security review)

Next steps / asks:
- Jordan / Sofia: please confirm preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and an approximate procurement SLA (e.g., typical review times for legal, security, finance).
- If helpful, Marcus can join your procurement/finance review to walk through pricing and invoicing details.
- I'll follow up with an updated MAP (attached) and propose a 30-min check-in next Wed (Mar 10) to align on dates.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & commercial path (PO vs Card / Marketplace) + MAP

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

1) Commercial path: For pilots at our scale this year, we generally require a PO when the expected spend is > $50k. For very small pilots (<= $10k) we can use a corporate card.
2) Marketplace: We'd prefer the marketplace option if pricing and entitlements match — it speeds procurement because it's standard terms. We'll need to see the exact SKUs and pricing you expect to expose there.
3) Contract: AcmeCloud prefers to sign our enterprise MSA if the vendor agrees; however, we can review Redwood's MSA as the starting point. If there are limited redlines, DocuSign workflow is fastest.
4) Security: Our InfoSec team will need an SSP + SOC2 report and answers to a short SAS questionnaire. Can you share the SOC2 evidence bundle and a filled SSP?

I'll loop in Sofia (cc'd) who handles vendor onboarding and POs. Sofia — can you confirm typical timelines for legal, InfoSec, and finance/PO issuance?

Jordan Hayes
Head of Cloud Engineering | AcmeCloud
jordan.hayes@acmecloud.com | 617-555-0199

Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & commercial path (PO vs Card / Marketplace) + MAP

Thanks, Jordan / Marissa. Quick confirmation of our internal averages so you can map the MAP to realistic dates: 

- Legal review (MSA / standard redlines): 5-10 business days (depends on counterparty redlines).
- InfoSec review (SSP + SOC2 review + short questionnaire): 7-14 business days. If the SSP + SOC2 bundle is comprehensive, this tends toward the shorter end.
- Finance / Procurement for PO issuance: 3-5 business days after legal and InfoSec approvals are in place.

Notes on paths: 
- PO path: Preferred for annual commitments. We will issue a PO referencing the signed MSA and either an SOW or invoice schedule.
- Card path: Only for one-off purchases or pilots under $10k; not used for production contracts.
- Marketplace: We often prefer marketplace purchases (AWS/GCP) if pricing and licensing align because it avoids SSO legal review in some cases — but finance needs to confirm if a marketplace invoice meets our supplier onboarding requirements.

Attachments I'm sharing from procurement side: 
- Procurement-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf (internal checklist for vendors; includes required tax docs and bank info).

Proposed tentative timeline for the MAP if we start next week: 
- Mar 9–12: Legal initial review
- Mar 15–19: InfoSec Q&A and evidence handoff
- Mar 22–24: Final legal signoff + finance PO prep
- Mar 25: Target PO issuance / marketplace order

Marissa — please re-send the MAP with those target windows and we'll confirm any internal blockers. Happy to schedule a procurement call if that helps (Sofia to own calendar invite).

Sofia Green
Senior Procurement Manager | AcmeCloud
